name: off-cooperating-boundary-entries-and-continuation
description: official-host.ts:1695 'cooperating boundary entries and continuation survive automatic rollover'. A helper turn_end hook (before posthorse) answers a 600,000-char completed response with its own entries (a custom entry, a context_edit replacing the seeded owner input, a continue-request custom message) and continue:true: posthorse's threshold boundary keeps all of them, records REPLACED_OWNER_INPUT (never PRIVATE_BEFORE_EDIT) and the continuation request runs (2 requests).
